groups.meta: five Index wagers, a Pluto infiltration, then a final Index
conditions: The wagers are 100,000, 120,000, 140,000, 160,000 and 180,000 credits. A win returns the wager with a profit; a loss burns it.
Match 4 needs a 20-point Victory Margin: if you win by more than 20 points, Nef Anyo backs out and the wager is lost.
Match 5 is scripted: you die when you deposit, and the match ends in defeat with the quest advancing. If you never deposit, it fails without advancing.
Out of credits mid-quest: set another quest active in the Codex to play normal Index matches and win them back.

groups.meta: 7.69% in A and B, 14.29% in C
conditions: Rounds run AABC, so rotation C comes every 4th round; every rotation can drop the parts.
Decryption slows with every extra squad member, so solo is faster.
Feed Antiserum Charges to the Vaporizers to keep all three consoles clear of the corrosive air; the mission fails if all three consoles are destroyed.
bonuses: Antiserum Charges drop more with Nekros' Desecrate, Hydroid, Ivara, Atlas, Khora or a Chesa Kubrow.
Operator mode avoids armor corrosion between Vaporizers.

disclosures.title: keep the Vaporizer loop moving
disclosures.body: Carry up to 3 Antiserum Charges and top each Vaporizer up before its bubble shrinks: full size drops to two-thirds after 20 seconds and one-third 10 seconds after that. Vacuum and Greedy Pull don't move the charges, so kill enemies close to the Vaporizers. Octavia's Mallet and Resonator can taunt the Infested into killing themselves.

disclosures.title: the Circuit route
disclosures.body: After The Duviri Paradox, Nidus is week 9 of the 11-week Normal Circuit, shared with Octavia and Harrow. Neuroptics at tier 2, Chassis at 5, Systems at 8 and the main blueprint at 10, so no quest. One frame per week; picking someone else means waiting a full rotation.
